llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: extremely low prices compared to market value, urgent sales language and tactics, broad product listing including high-demand brands, ambiguous or generic company name not found in legitimate registries, lack of functional hyperlinks—including those for contact, privacy policy, and company information—despite listing these in the page text. The privacy/data handling is not clearly noted. Payment options mimic standard platforms but may be spoofed. No verifiable company address, phone, or registration info is present. No way to verify the legitimacy of claims or process returns. All this demonstrates a textbook case of a fake online shopping scam.
